title: Banks Act Directive D5/2024 — Loss absorbency requirements for additional tier 1 and tier 2 capital instruments
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Loss absorbency requirements for additional tier 1 and tier 2 capital instruments.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Loss absorbency requirements for additional tier 1 and tier 2 capital instruments.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Loss absorbency requirements for additional tier 1 and tier 2 capital instruments. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
